bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GYEN has issuer-native issuance rails on Ethereum, Solana, and Stellar, with issuer-operated swaps among those rails. Arbitrum is not an independent issuer rail: its verified ArbToken_v1 binds l1Address() to Ethereum GYEN and exposes gateway-only bridgeMint/bridgeBurn through the Arbitrum L2 custom gateway. The Arbitrum canonical-rollup representation's gateway mint/burn, token administration, and proxy-upgrade controls are assessed here; current escrow balances, pause state, and end-to-end execution were not independently replayed.

controls.label: Arbitrum GYEN L2 custom gateway bridge mint-burn

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The Arbitrum custom gateway is the route's L2 bridge endpoint; the reviewed path is an Ethereum L1 custom-gateway deposit/escrow plus gateway-controlled mint on Arbitrum and burn on withdrawal. The L1 counterpart is 0xcee284f754e854890e311e3280b767f80797180d and the router is 0x5288c571fd7ad117bea99bf60fe0846c4e84f933.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: ArbToken_v1 l1Address() returned Ethereum GYEN 0xc08512927d12348f6620a698105e1baac6ecd911 and l2Gateway() returned 0x096760f208390250649e3e8763348e783aef5562; the verified L2CustomGateway implementation points to counterpart L1 custom gateway 0xcee284f754e854890e311e3280b767f80797180d.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: The observed mechanics are consistent with a canonical lock-mint route, but current L1 escrow balances and end-to-end deposit/withdraw execution were not independently replayed; whole-supply reconciliation remains unknown.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The L2 gateway proxy admin slot returned 0xd570ace65c43af47101fc6250fd6fc63d1c22a86 at the observation block; current route pause state was not independently replayed.

controls.capDescription: Arbitrum GYEN bridgeMint and bridgeBurn are gateway-only on the representation token; route-level supply conservation depends on the paired L1 custom gateway and escrow/deposit accounting.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495313166, verified ArbToken_v1 at 0x589d35656641d6ab57a545f08cf473ecd9b6d5f7 returned l1Address() = 0xc08512927d12348f6620a698105e1baac6ecd911 and l2Gateway() = 0x096760f208390250649e3e8763348e783aef5562. Its verified bridgeMint and bridgeBurn functions are restricted to that L2 custom gateway. The verified gateway implementation 0x190274fea8f30e3f48ce43adcbd9a74110118284 points to counterpart L1 custom gateway 0xcee284f754e854890e311e3280b767f80797180d and router 0x5288c571fd7ad117bea99bf60fe0846c4e84f933.
